TermTranslation.definition: One of 2 genes that normally help stop cell growth. If they are abnormal they increase the risk of getting breast cancer or other cancers
A physical exam of the breasts and nearby lymph nodes
Tissue in the breast that has more connective tissues, glands and milk ducts than fatty tissue.
Looking at someone’s DNA to see if there is a permanent change in a gene that may mean the person has a higher risk for getting a disease.
An x-ray picture of the soft tissue of the breast.
